memories.title: User prefers dark mode interface
memories.content: The user has indicated a strong preference for dark mode across all applications, especially for late-night coding sessions. They find light mode causes eye strain after 2+ hours of work.

memories.title: PostgreSQL is the primary production database
memories.content: The team decided on July 15, 2026 to use PostgreSQL 16 as the sole production database for all new services. Legacy MySQL instances are being phased out with a target completion of Q4 2026. Connection pooling is handled via PgBouncer.

memories.title: Redis v7 migration completed successfully
memories.content: The Redis cache layer was migrated from v6.2 to v7.0 on July 20, 2026. Performance benchmarks show a 35% improvement in cache hit latency and 22% reduction in memory usage. Zero downtime was achieved via rolling upgrade with sentinel failover.

memories.title: Project Alpha deadline August 15, 2026
memories.content: Project Alpha (client: Acme Corp) has a hard delivery deadline of August 15, 2026. The client requires weekly progress reports every Friday by 5 PM EST. The current completion rate is 78%, with authentication module being the primary blocker.

memories.title: Security audit findings require immediate action
memories.content: The Q3 security audit (conducted July 22, 2026) identified 3 critical vulnerabilities in the authentication service. The team decided to prioritize fixing CVE-2026-12345 (SQL injection in login endpoint) before the August 15 deadline. All fixes must go through the new security review board.

memories.title: Client satisfaction scores trending upward
memories.content: Monthly NPS survey results for Q2 2026 show an upward trend: April 72, May 76, June 81. The engineering team's faster response times and the new documentation portal were cited as the top two drivers. Target for Q3 is 85.
